# wso2is_organization (Data Source)

Looks up an organization by ID or name. The search covers all organizations below the provider's organization.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "wso2is_organization" "partner" {
  name = "Partner Inc"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Organization ID.
- `name` (String) Organization name.

### Read-Only

- `attributes` (Map of String) Custom attributes.
- `description` (String) Description.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether it is active.
- `handle` (String) Organization handle.
- `parent_id` (String) Parent organization ID.
- `type` (String) `TENANT` or `STRUCTURAL`.
